title: VoltPilot MQTT Multi-Entity Telemetry Payload (telemetry 2.0)
description: The v2 per-entity telemetry uplink published by a v2 edge on ems/{tenant_id}/{site_id}/{device_id}/v2/telemetry (QoS1, NOT retained). Successor of the FROZEN mqtt-telemetry.schema.json (1.0), which stays untouched on its own topic - coexistence is by SEPARATE TOPIC in the per-device v2/# subtree (README decision D-2; dual-CONSUME cloud-side, never dual-publish on old devices). Instead of the frozen 5-channel measurement whitelist, 2.0 carries N entities, each with free-form numeric channels declared by the entity's registry capabilities (edge/entities/{id}/config). The cloud ingest validates the ENVELOPE ONLY: identity (topic == payload), id formats, timestamps, and the structural shape - channel NAMES are deliberately not validated against the registry (the capability set is edge/portal concern; an unknown channel is data, not an error).
x-topic: ems/{tenant_id}/{site_id}/{device_id}/v2/telemetry  (Edge -> Cloud, QoS1, not retained; the device_id is the edge GATEWAY device carrying the mTLS identity - entities live under it)
x-channels: Channel values are ALWAYS numbers (a boolean state is 0/1). Sign conventions are fixed per capability, shared with the command vocabulary: storage battery_power_kw + = charge / - = discharge; grid power_kw + = import / - = export; generation (pv_power_kw) >= 0. The per-entity channel vocabulary is declared in the entity registry; the pilot entity types ship battery-hybrid (soc_pct, battery_power_kw, pv_power_kw), producer (pv_power_kw) and grid-meter (power_kw).

schema_version.description: Payload contract version. 2.0 = the multi-entity successor of mqtt-telemetry 1.0.

ts.description: Observation timestamp (RFC 3339, UTC) for every entity that does not carry its own ts. Original at emission time; a store-and-forward edge replays with ORIGINAL timestamps (the v1 rule - the cloud writer keys liveness on arrival time, not this field).

seq.description: Monotonic per-device sequence number for gap detection (the v1 field, optional).

entities.description: Per-entity channel readings, keyed by entity id from the entity registry. An entity with nothing to report is simply absent - never fabricated zeros (the v1 sources discipline).

ts.description: OPTIONAL per-entity observation time overriding the top-level ts (entities read at different cadences may share one uplink message).

channels.description: Flat numeric readings, keyed by channel name (snake_case, the v1 measurement-key style).
